recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically split composition featuring a central couple standing on a reflective surface. The top half is a stark white void dominated by massive red block numerals containing internal narrative vignettes. The bottom half is an inverted, dark, cool-toned reflection showing a chaotic urban scene with silhouettes and explosions.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the upright figures and their inverted reflection
Contrast between the clinical white top and the dense, dark bottom
Integration of complex scenes inside the negative space of large numerals
Vertical stacking of text flanking the central focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central couple at 1:1 scale relative to the horizon, positioned exactly in the middle of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red numerals in the upper background act as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central couple, move up to the red numerals, then drop down into the detailed reflection below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the top half creates a 'floating' effect for the primary subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Crimson Red (Upper Typography and Vignettes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements against a desaturated, low-value bottom half.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, white, black, and teal-blue

letterConstructionRules: Internal masking of illustrations within large characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals act as containers for secondary illustrations
Letters are rotated 90 degrees or stacked vertically to fit narrow side margins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform block style across all text elements to maintain a cohesive 'athletic' or 'street' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric rigidity.
Matches the chamfered, athletic block aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen illustration. Top half: pure white background with a central couple in silhouette. Bottom half: an inverted reflection of the couple on a cracked ice surface, showing a dark, teal-toned urban night scene with silhouettes of police and explosions. Leave space for large block text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, red-tinted block numerals in the upper background behind the couple. Fill the numerals with red-toned comic-style vignettes. Add vertically stacked block text on the left and right margins in black and red.

verificationChecks: Is the reflection perfectly aligned with the upright subjects?
Are the vignettes inside the numerals monochromatic red?
Is the horizon line perfectly horizontal and centered?

adjustableVariables: Color of the reflection (e.g., purple vs teal)
mustRedesign: Exact layout of the internal vignettes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text on the sides is legible despite vertical stacking.
Check that the reflection contains different narrative details than the top half.
Verify the red in the numerals is the most vibrant element in the top half.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Large masked background typography + Inverted narrative reflection + High-contrast tri-color palette.
